blocks.text: Alkenes unsaturated hydrocarbons hain aur zyada tar electrophilic addition reactions karte hain. Doosri, chhoti qismon mein oxidation, combustion aur polymerisation shamil hain. Addition reactions aur un ke mechanisms 11.8.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Addition aur elimination reaction mein farq wazeh karein, aur addition molecule ki saturation kyun barhata hai (Quick Check 11.7b, 11.9ii; exercise Q.2d).
blocks.explanation: Addition mein chhota molecule double bond ke paar jurta hai, jo khul kar do single bonds banta hai, to product mein carbons se zyada atoms jure hain aur koi multiple bond nahi: woh zyada saturated hai. Elimination us ka ulta hai: pani ya HBr jaisa chhota molecule sath wale carbons se hata kar double bond banaya jata hai. Ethanol ki dehydration ethene deti hai; ethene ki hydration ethanol wapas deti hai.

items: Alkenes zyada tar electrophilic addition karte hain; oxidation, combustion aur polymerisation bhi.
